 Why we built $PUMP
 From the fastest-growing launchpad in history to a network for instant trading & attention.
 Since launching in January 2024, Pump.fun set out to become a household name, letting anyone, anywhere create and trade tokens.
 Pump.fun quickly became the fastest-growing company in history, reaching $100M, $300M, and $500M in revenue faster than any other company in the world. But that was just the beginning.
 To unlock further growth, we launched $PUMP , the official native token of the Pump.fun protocols, delivering value to its community and incentivizing the ecosystem that helps the platform succeed.
